';
const FLYING_SPRITES=new Set(['gull','pelican','osprey','eagle','crow','ptero','bat','vampire','mosquito','wasp','dragon','mech']);
const FLAP_CYCLE=[0,1,2,3,2,1];
const SPR={
 gull:[[0,0,256,256],[256,0,256,256],[512,0,256,256],[768,0,256,256]],
 pelican:[[0,256,256,256],[256,256,256,256],[512,256,256,256],[768,256,256,256]],
 osprey:[[0,512,256,256],[256,512,256,256],[512,512,256,256],[768,512,256,256]],
 eagle:[[0,768,256,256],[256,768,256,256],[512,768,256,256],[768,768,256,256]],
 crow:[[0,1024,256,256],[256,1024,256,256],[512,1024,256,256],[768,1024,256,256]],
 ptero:[[0,1280,256,256],[256,1280,256,256],[512,1280,256,256],[768,1280,256,256]],
 bat:[[0,1536,256,256],[256,1536,256,256],[512,1536,256,256],[768,1536,256,256]],
 vampire:[[0,1792,256,256],[256,1792,256,256],[512,1792,256,256],[768,1792,256,256]],
 mosquito:[[0,2048,256,256],[256,2048,256,256],[512,2048,256,256],[768,2048,256,256]],
 wasp:[[0,2304,256,256],[256,2304,256,256],[512,2304,256,256],[768,2304,256,256]],
 dragon:[[0,2560,256,256],[256,2560,256,256],[512,2560,256,256],[768,2560,256,256]],
 mech:[[0,2816,256,256],[256,2816,256,256],[512,2816,256,256],[768,2816,256,256]],
 alligator:[852,745,289,164], gorilla:[1138,687,246,225], sailboat:[1383,464,274,309], speedboat:[1392,795,269,114]
 };
 const STAGES=[
  {name:'Gull', sprite:'gull', size:58, need:0, next:12, speed:250},
  {name:'Pelican', sprite:'pelican', size:70, need:12, next:28, speed:260},
  {name:'Osprey', sprite:'osprey', size:74, need:28, next:50, speed:275},
  {name:'Bald Eagle', sprite:'eagle', size:82, need:50, next:78, speed:290},
  {name:'Pterodactyl', sprite:'ptero', size:94, need:78, next:112, speed:305},
  {name:'Green Dragon', sprite:'dragon', size:104, need:112, next:152, speed:320},
  {name:'Mech Dragon', sprite:'mech', size:110, need:152, next:9999, speed:335},
 ];
 const WORLD={w:5200,h:1200,sky:0,ocean:440,shore:665,grass:735};
 let score=0,best=+localStorage.getItem('gullRunEvoBest2')||0, time=0, last=0, playing=false, cam={x:0,y:0}, keys={};
 bestEl.textContent=best;
 let player, foods=[], enemies=[], grounds=[], boats=[], ufos=[], particles=[], lasers=[], clouds=[], islands=[];
 function rand(a,b){return a+Math.random()*(b-a)} function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v))} function dist(a,b){return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)}
 function screen(obj){return {x:obj.x-cam.x,y:obj.y-cam.y};}
 function initBackground(){ clouds=Array.from({length:18},()=>({x:rand(0,WORLD.w),y:rand(40,320),s:rand(55,140),p:rand(0,10)})); islands=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>({x:600+i*800+rand(-140,140),w:rand(220,380),h:rand(110,190)})); }
 function makeFood(){ const types=['fish','burger','ham','hotdog']; const type=types[(Math.random()*types.length)|0]; const zone=Math.random(); const y=zone<.35?rand(180,390):zone<.75?rand(520,640):rand(690,810); return {type,x:rand(90,WORLD.w-90),y,r:26,score:10+(Math.random()*8|0),xp:1}; }
 function makeEnemy(kind){ const map={crow:'crow',bat:'bat',vampire:'vampire',mosquito:'mosquito',wasp:'wasp',ptero:'ptero'}; const y = kind==='ptero'? rand(220,470) : rand(130,500); return {kind,sprite:map[kind],x:rand(200,WORLD.w-200),y,vx:rand(-90,90),vy:rand(-30,30),size:kind==='ptero'?86:kind.includes('bat')?72:kind==='crow'?74:66,phase:rand(0,10),hp:1}; }
 function makeGround(kind){ return {kind,x:rand(180,WORLD.w-180),y:rand(WORLD.grass+65,WORLD.h-120),size:kind==='gorilla'?120:132,phase:rand(0,10)}; }
 function seed(){ foods=Array.from({length:70}, makeFood); enemies=[]; const types=['crow','bat','vampire','mosquito','wasp','ptero']; for(let i=0;i<36;i++) enemies.push(makeEnemy(types[i%types.length])); grounds=[]; for(let i=0;i<14;i++) grounds.push(makeGround(i%2?'gorilla':'alligator')); boats=[]; for(let i=0;i<6;i++) boats.push({kind:i%2?'speedboat':'sailboat',x:rand(200,WORLD.w-200),y:rand(WORLD.ocean+90,WORLD.shore-35),vx:rand(28,62)*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),phase:rand(0,10)}); ufos=Array.from({length:5},()=>({x:rand(250,WORLD.w-250),y:rand(50,180),vx:rand(40,70)*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),size:70,hp:2})); particles=[]; lasers=[]; initBackground(); }
 function start(){ player={x:320,y:WORLD.ocean+170,vx:0,vy:0,hp:100,inv:0,xp:0,stage:0,frame:0,edge:0,laser:0}; score=0; scoreEl.textContent='0'; seed(); overlay.hidden=true; hud.hidden=false; playing=true; updateHud(); }
 function updateHud(){ const s=STAGES[player.stage]; stageEl.textContent=s.name; healthText.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.round(player.hp)); hpEl.style.width=clamp(player.hp,0,100)+'%'; const prev=s.need, next=s.next; const local=player.xp-prev; const span=Math.max(1,next-prev); xpEl.style.width=(player.stage===STAGES.length-1?100:clamp(local/span*100,0,100))+'%'; xpText.textContent=(player.stage===STAGES.length-1)?'MAX':`${Math.max(0,Math.floor(local))} / ${span}`; }
 playBtn.onclick=start;
 let atlasReady=false, flightReady=false, backgroundReady=false;
 function updateArtReady(){ if(atlasReady&&flightReady&&backgroundReady){ playBtn.disabled=false; playBtn.textContent='PLAY'; } }
 function artFailed(){ playBtn.disabled=true; playBtn.textContent='ART FAILED TO LOAD'; }
 atlas.onload=()=>{ atlasReady=true; updateArtReady(); };
 flightAtlas.onload=()=>{ flightReady=true; updateArtReady(); };
 backgroundAtlas.onload=()=>{ backgroundReady=true; updateArtReady(); };
 atlas.onerror=artFailed; flightAtlas.onerror=artFailed; backgroundAtlas.onerror=artFailed;
 addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=1; if(e.key.startsWith('Arrow')) e.preventDefault();}); addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key.toLowerCase()]=0);
 let joystick={x:0,y:0}, joyId=null; function moveJoy(e){ const r=joy.getBoundingClientRect(); let dx=e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2, dy=e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2; const m=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1, lim=36, used=Math.min(lim,m); joystick.x=dx/m*used/lim; joystick.y=dy/m*used/lim; knob.style.transform=`translate(${joystick.x*34}px,${joystick.y*34}px)`; } joy.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{joyId=e.pointerId; joy.setPointerCapture(joyId); moveJoy(e);}); joy.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(e.pointerId===joyId) moveJoy(e);}); function endJoy(e){ if(e.pointerId!==joyId) return; joyId=null; joystick.x=joystick.y=0; knob.style.transform='translate(0,0)'; } joy.addEventListener('pointerup',endJoy); joy.addEventListener('pointercancel',endJoy);
 let mouse={on:false,x:0,y:0}; canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{ if(e.pointerType==='mouse'){ mouse.on=true; mouse.x=e.clientX; mouse.y=e.clientY; } }); canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{ if(e.pointerType==='mouse'){ mouse.x=e.clientX; mouse.y=e.clientY; } }); canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>mouse.on=false); canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>mouse.on=false);
 function drawSprite(name, frame, x,y,w,h, flip=false){ const source=FLYING_SPRITES.has(name)?flightAtlas:atlas, frames=SPR[name]; const r=Array.isArray(frames[0]) ? frames[frame%frames.length] : frames; ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); if(flip) ctx.scale(-1,1); ctx.drawImage(source, r[0],r[1],r[2],r[3], -w/2,-h/2,w,h); ctx.restore(); }
 function drawFood(f){ const q=screen(f); ctx.save(); ctx.translate(q.x,q.y); ctx.scale(1.2,1.2); if(f.type==='burger'){ ctx.fillStyle='#c77e2a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-18,-9,36,9,6); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='#52b543'; ctx.fillRect(-15,-1,30,5); ctx.fillStyle='#5d2b16'; ctx.fillRect(-14,3,28,5); ctx.fillStyle='#f0c44f'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-18,8,36,8,6); ctx.fill(); } else if(f.type==='hotdog'){ ctx.fillStyle='#d98a2e'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.roundRect(-20,-6,40,12,8); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle='#e34e2d'; ctx.lineWidth=5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-12,0); ctx.lineTo(12,0); ctx.stroke(); } else if(f.type==='ham'){ ctx.fillStyle='#c96b47'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,15,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='#efb08e'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0,0,9,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); } else { ctx.fillStyle='#ffb54c'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,16,10,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='#f17b2e'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-3,-1,6,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(5,2,5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); } ctx.restore(); }
 function drawUfo(u){ const q=screen(u); ctx.save(); ctx.translate(q.x,q.y); ctx.fillStyle='#6e7c92'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,9,35,14,0,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='#8ed7f8'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(0,0,22,16,0,Math.PI,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle='#ff4c59'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); }
 function drawBackground(){ if(backgroundReady){ ctx.drawImage(backgroundAtlas,-cam.x,-cam.y,WORLD.w,WORLD.h); return; } const sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H); sky.addColorStop(0,'#1f7ff0'); sky.addColorStop(.4,'#72c7ff'); sky.addColorStop(.72,'#8fe3ff'); sky.addColorStop(1,'#c9ffef'); ctx.fillStyle=sky; ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // sun rays
  ctx.save(); ctx.translate(W*.74,80); for(let i=0;i<12;i++){ ctx.rotate(Math.PI/6); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,220,.08)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-18,0); ctx.lineTo(18,0); ctx.lineTo(120,640); ctx.lineTo(-120,640); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); } ctx.restore();
  // clouds
  for(const c of clouds){ const x=(c.x-cam.x*0.35)% (WORLD.w+300), sx=x< -200?x+WORLD.w+300:x; const y=c.y-cam.y*0.1; drawCloud(sx,y,c.s); }
  // ocean horizon and islands
  const horizon= WORLD.ocean-cam.y; ctx.fillStyle='#1d80cf'; ctx.fillRect(0,horizon,W,WORLD.shore-WORLD.ocean);
  for(let i=0;i<28;i++){ const y=horizon+20+i*8; ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${0.18-i*0.004})`; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath(); for(let x=-30;x<W+40;x+=40){ ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+20,y+Math.sin((x*0.03)+time*2+i)*3,x+40,y); } ctx.stroke(); }
  for(const isl of islands){ const ix=isl.x-cam.x*0.55, by=WORLD.shore-cam.y-10; ctx.fillStyle='#699d62'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ix-isl.w/2,by); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ix-isl.w*.3,by-isl.h*.3,ix-isl.w*.12,by-isl.h*.55); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ix+isl.w*.05,by-isl.h*.9,ix+isl.w*.35,by-isl.h*.35); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ix+isl.w*.45,by-isl.h*.2,ix+isl.w/2,by); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='#425f88'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ix-isl.w/2,by); ctx.lineTo(ix-isl.w*.1,by-isl.h*.92); ctx.lineTo(ix+isl.w*.55,by); ctx.closePath(); ctx.globalAlpha=.28; ctx.fill(); ctx.globalAlpha=1; }
  // lighthouse
  const lx=140-cam.x*0.6, ly=WORLD.shore-cam.y-24; ctx.fillStyle='#f5f8fb'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(lx-10,ly); ctx.lineTo(lx+10,ly); ctx.lineTo(lx+18,ly-92); ctx.lineTo(lx-18,ly-92); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle='#2c4d71'; ctx.fillRect(lx-20,ly-98,40,10); ctx.fillRect(lx-16,ly-112,32,14); ctx.fillStyle='#fff1a8'; ctx.fillRect(lx-9,ly-108,18,8);
  // sand and grass
  const sandY=WORLD.shore-cam.y; ctx.fillStyle='#f6e0a3'; ctx.fillRect(0,sandY,W,44); ctx.fillStyle='#8ed96c'; ctx.fillRect(0,WORLD.grass-cam.y,W,H); ctx.fillStyle='#5aa54b'; ctx.fillRect(0,WORLD.grass-cam.y,W,16); // top edge
  for(let i=0;i<12;i++){ const fx=((i*150)-cam.x*0.8)% (W+200); const x0=fx< -80?fx+W+200:fx; const y0=WORLD.grass-cam.y+8; ctx.strokeStyle='#f6fff2'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0,y0+20); ctx.lineTo(x0+6,y0+8); ctx.lineTo(x0+12,y0+20); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle='#fff6c5'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x0+6,y0+6,5,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
 }
 function drawCloud(x,y,s){ ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x,y); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.92)'; for(const p of [[-s*.25,4,s*.24],[0,-s*.08,s*.3],[s*.26,2,s*.22],[s*.45,10,s*.15]]){ ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p[0],p[1],p[2],0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); } ctx.fillRect(-s*.46,0,s*.95,s*.22); ctx.restore(); }
 function drawGroundEnemy(g){ const q=screen(g); if(g.kind==='alligator') drawSprite('alligator',0,q.x,q.y,g.size,g.size*0.56,false); else drawSprite('gorilla',0,q.x,q.y,g.size*0.92,g.size,false); }
 function drawBoat(b){ const q=screen(b); const bob=Math.sin(time*2+b.phase)*5; drawSprite(b.kind,0,q.x,q.y+bob,b.kind==='sailboat'?140:124,b.kind==='sailboat'?182:82,b.vx<0); }
 function drawEnemy(e){ const q=screen(e); const cycle=(Math.floor(time*10+e.phase*10)%FLAP_CYCLE.length+FLAP_CYCLE.length)%FLAP_CYCLE.length; drawSprite(e.sprite,FLAP_CYCLE[cycle],q.x,q.y,e.size,e.size,false); }
 function drawPlayer(){ if(!player) return; const q=screen(player); const stage=STAGES[player.stage]; const cycle=(Math.floor(player.frame)%FLAP_CYCLE.length+FLAP_CYCLE.length)%FLAP_CYCLE.length; drawSprite(stage.sprite,FLAP_CYCLE[cycle],q.x,q.y,stage.size,stage.size,player.vx<0); }
 function particleBurst(x,y,col,n){ for(let i=0;i<n;i++) particles.push({x,y,vx:rand(-120,120),vy:rand(-130,20),life:rand(.35,.8),col}); }
 function hit(amount,src){ if(player.inv>0) return; player.hp-=amount; player.inv=.55; if(src){ const dx=player.x-src.x,dy=player.y-src.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1; player.vx+=dx/d*90; player.vy+=dy/d*90; } particleBurst(player.x,player.y,'#ff6363',12); if(player.hp<=0){ playing=false; overlay.hidden=false; hud.hidden=true; playBtn.textContent='PLAY AGAIN'; if(score>best){ best=score; localStorage.setItem('gullRunEvoBest2',best); bestEl.textContent=best; } } }
 function checkEvolution(){ while(player.stage<STAGES.length-1 && player.xp>=STAGES[player.stage+1].need){ player.stage++; player.hp=Math.min(100,player.hp+20); particleBurst(player.x,player.y,'#ffe06e',24); } }
 function edible(e){ return player.stage>=Math.min(6, ['crow','bat','vampire','mosquito','wasp','ptero'].indexOf(e.kind)+1); }
 function update(dt){ time+=dt; if(!playing||!player) return; const stage=STAGES[player.stage];
   let dx=(keys.d||keys.arrowright?1:0)-(keys.a||keys.arrowleft?1:0)+joystick.x; let dy=(keys.s||keys.arrowdown?1:0)-(keys.w||keys.arrowup?1:0)+joystick.y; if(mouse.on){ const worldX=cam.x+mouse.x, worldY=cam.y+mouse.y; dx += (worldX-player.x)/200; dy += (worldY-player.y)/200; } const mag=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1; if(mag>1){dx/=mag;dy/=mag;} const accel=560; player.vx += dx*accel*dt; player.vy += dy*accel*dt; player.vx*=0.93; player.vy*=0.93; const sp=Math.hypot(player.vx,player.vy); if(sp>stage.speed){ player.vx=player.vx/sp*stage.speed; player.vy=player.vy/sp*stage.speed; } player.x=clamp(player.x+player.vx*dt,50,WORLD.w-50); player.y=clamp(player.y+player.vy*dt,20,WORLD.h-20); player.frame += dt*10; player.inv=Math.max(0,player.inv-dt); player.edge=Math.max(0,player.edge-dt); player.laser=Math.max(0,player.laser-dt);
   if((player.y<=22 || player.y>=WORLD.h-22) && player.edge<=0){ player.edge=.6; hit(8,{x:player.x,y:player.y<100?0:WORLD.h}); }
   for(const f of foods){ if(dist(player,f)<36+STAGES[player.stage].size*.36){ player.xp += f.xp; score += f.score; scoreEl.textContent=score; Object.assign(f, makeFood()); checkEvolution(); } }
   for(const e of enemies){ e.x += e.vx*dt; e.y += e.vy*dt + Math.sin(time*3+e.phase)*22*dt; if(e.x<80||e.x>WORLD.w-80)e.vx*=-1; if(e.y<70||e.y>WORLD.grass-40)e.vy*=-1; const collision = dist(player,e) < (STAGES[player.stage].size + e.size)*0.36; if(collision){ if(edible(e)){ score+=30; scoreEl.textContent=score; player.xp+=1; Object.assign(e, makeEnemy(e.kind)); checkEvolution(); particleBurst(e.x,e.y,'#8fff7b',12); } else hit(9,e); } }
   for(const g of grounds){ if(dist(player,g)<(STAGES[player.stage].size+g.size)*0.33) hit(14,g); }
   for(const b of boats){ b.x += b.vx*dt; if(b.x<100||b.x>WORLD.w-100) b.vx*=-1; const by=b.y+Math.sin(time*2+b.phase)*5; if(Math.abs(player.x-b.x)<60 && Math.abs(player.y-by)<50) hit(12,{x:b.x,y:by}); }
   for(const u of ufos){ u.x += u.vx*dt; if(u.x<120||u.x>WORLD.w-120) u.vx*=-1; if(dist(player,u)<(STAGES[player.stage].size+u.size)*0.35) hit(16,u); }
   if(STAGES[player.stage].sprite==='mech' && player.laser<=0){ let target=null, bestD=420; for(const u of ufos){ const d=dist(player,u); if(d<bestD){bestD=d;target=u;} } if(target){ lasers.push({x1:player.x+30,y1:player.y-6,x2:target.x,y2:target.y,life:.16}); target.hp-=1; player.laser=.28; if(target.hp<=0){ score+=60; scoreEl.textContent=score; target.x=rand(250,WORLD.w-250); target.y=rand(50,180); target.hp=2; particleBurst(target.x,target.y,'#7bff8b',18); } } }
   for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){ const p=particles[i]; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.life-=dt; if(p.life<=0) particles.splice(i,1); } for(let i=lasers.length-1;i>=0;i--){ lasers[i].life-=dt; if(lasers[i].life<=0) lasers.splice(i,1); }
   cam.x=clamp(player.x-W/2,0,WORLD.w-W); cam.y=clamp(player.y-H/2,0,WORLD.h-H); updateHud();
 }
 function draw(){ ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H); drawBackground();
   // draw boats in water first
   for(const b of boats) drawBoat(b);
   // foods, ufos, flying enemies, ground, player, fx
   for(const f of foods){ const q=screen(f); if(q.x>-50&&q.x<W+50&&q.y>-50&&q.y<H+50) drawFood(f); }
   for(const u of ufos){ const q=screen(u); if(q.x>-80&&q.x<W+80&&q.y>-80&&q.y<H+80) drawUfo(u); }
   for(const e of enemies){ const q=screen(e); if(q.x>-120&&q.x<W+120&&q.y>-120&&q.y<H+120) drawEnemy(e); }
   for(const g of grounds){ const q=screen(g); if(q.x>-150&&q.x<W+150&&q.y>-150&&q.y<H+150) drawGroundEnemy(g); }
   for(const l of lasers){ const a=screen({x:l.x1,y:l.y1}), b=screen({x:l.x2,y:l.y2}); ctx.save(); ctx.strokeStyle='#7cff61'; ctx.lineWidth=6; ctx.shadowColor='#abff8a'; ctx.shadowBlur=14; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a.x,a.y); ctx.lineTo(b.x,b.y); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore(); }
   for(const p of particles){ const q=screen(p); ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,p.life/.8); ctx.fillStyle=p.col; ctx.fillRect(q.x,q.y,4,4); } ctx.globalAlpha=1;
   drawPlayer();
 }
 function loop(ts){ const dt=Math.min(.024,(ts-last)/1000||0); last=ts; update(dt); draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); } requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script></body></html>
